name: LaunchBar
description: LaunchBar is a macOS productivity launcher for finding local content, opening apps and files, navigating data and running built-in or custom actions.
agentUseSummary: LaunchBar is visible as a local-runtime security preview. Relay will not invoke mutable action bundles or LaunchBar's broad built-in commands until a Mac-local bridge can bind inspected content and enforce a narrow action contract.

capabilities.label: Run approved local actions
capabilities.description: After local bridge hardening, invoke only an inspected, content-bound LaunchBar action with its exact approved argument and result contract.

blocked.label: Run a LaunchBar action from Railway
blocked.description: LaunchBar is a Mac application with local indexes and actions; Relay will not invent a cloud API or export device authority to Railway.

blocked.label: Trust an action identifier or bundle path
blocked.description: A custom action's script can change while its identifier or path remains stable, so those selectors are not immutable authority boundaries.

blocked.label: Run an unreviewed custom action
blocked.description: LaunchBar actions can execute JavaScript, AppleScript, shell scripts, Unix executables and other languages with local user authority.

blocked.label: Run an unbounded built-in action
blocked.description: LaunchBar includes file mutation, clipboard, application-control, command-line and system-management actions that cannot share one generic permission.

blocked.label: Run actions before local bridge hardening
blocked.description: No discover, inspect or invoke action is callable until a local bridge verifies action content, arguments, result bounds, side effects, auditing, drift and revocation.

approvalProfiles.label: Local bridge review required
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and execution remain unavailable until Relay can bind immutable action content and separately constrain scripts, arguments, results and local side effects.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tool is callable until a hardened Mac-local bridge can bind and audit an exact LaunchBar action contract.
No Hermes tool is callable until a hardened Mac-local bridge can bind and audit an exact LaunchBar action contract.

providerSetup.blocker: LaunchBar exposes mutable local action bundles and broad built-in actions spanning scripts, files, clipboard, applications, commands and system controls without a Relay-safe immutable action boundary.
providerSetup.nextAction: Implement a Mac-local bridge that inventories and hashes the exact action bundle, pins its identifier and signer where available, validates typed arguments and bounded results, separates side-effect classes, audits locally, detects drift and revokes changed actions.

evidence.supports: Objective Development documents LaunchBar's scriptable action bundles, background shell commands, file operations, application control, clipboard actions and system-management actions.
The official developer reference documents action bundles, action metadata, script types, code signing, script arguments and outputs, and JavaScript APIs.
Objective Development documents automatic indexing and invocation of AppleScripts, shell scripts, Unix executables, Automator workflows and macOS services.
Current release notes confirm maintained custom actions, script templates, shell-script execution and URL-triggered action identifiers.
